title: Holding group subsidiaries
goal: Show parent ownership of operating subsidiaries.

rubric.must: Harbour Group plc is visibly the single parent at the top.
Technology, Retail, Property, and Ventures subsidiaries visibly connect beneath the parent.
Visible labels show 100%, 80%, and 60% ownership interests on the appropriate subsidiaries.
Technology, Retail, and Property operating divisions visibly nest under their companies.
Company names and ownership text are readable.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all five rules, while Image 2 uses the wrong parent and subsidiaries, omits the 80% and 60% interests, and lacks operating divisions.
